lessons.title: What generative AI is
lessons.slo: Describe generative AI as technology that can create human-like content using learned patterns, not magic.

options.rationale: This matches the course idea of generative AI. It creates human-like content by using patterns it learned.

source_summary: Beginner introduction to generative AI, tokenization and embeddings, next-token prediction, prompts/history/RAG, AI agents, and multi-agent systems.
thought_process: Step 1: Kept the lesson structure, exercises, and flashcards unchanged.
Step 2: Added concise feedback for every correct answer and every incorrect choice.
Step 3: Kept explanations tied only to ideas stated in the course content.
Step 4: Wrote short, encouraging feedback with simple language and everyday workplace-style framing where helpful.
Step 5: Avoided restricted terms in feedback and kept all content within the given concepts.
